title: Concept: poetry.lock entry without file hashes
description: poetry.lock declares a locked package that records no file hashes, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Nothing ties the downloaded distribution to the lockfile, so a mirror or proxy can serve different bytes for the same version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through poetry.lock (pypi).
risk: Nothing ties the downloaded distribution to the lockfile, so a mirror or proxy can serve different bytes for the same version.
